subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Protecting nature sometimes means thinking beyond human borders.”?
options: It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.
But after many years, it can become a record of ordinary days.
Birds do not carry passports, but they depend on many nations.
When knowledge is shared carefully, improvement can come from many hands.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

本文可直接核對「Protecting nature sometimes means thinking beyond human borders. Birds do not carry passports, but they depend on many nations.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Protecting nature sometimes means thinking beyond human borders. Birds do not carry passports, but they depend on many nations.」，答案為「Birds do not carry passports, but they depend on many nations.」。
